CMS_CTM_STATUS_QUERY: SELECT substr(color_code,3,length(color_code)-2) color FROM (select color_code, count(*) total from (SELECT a.EXTRACT_NAME, a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, a.STATUS, CASE a.STATUS WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN '2_GREEN' WHEN 'DATA_POPULATED' THEN '3_BLUE' WHEN 'NO_ELIGIBLE_DATA' THEN '3_BLUE' ELSE '1_RED' END COLOR_CODE FROM xxcms.XXCMS_INTERFACE_TRACKING A,(SELECT EXTRACT_NAME, MAX(RECORD_ID) RECORD_ID FROM xxcms.XXCMS_INTERFACE_TRACKING WHERE source_type = 'CTM' AND extract_name IN (   'CUSTOMER_MASTER','CUSTOMER_CONTACTS','ALTERNATE_PAYER','OP_AR_EXTRACT','CL_AR_EXTRACT','SIH_EXTRACT','SII_EXTRACT') GROUP BY EXTRACT_NAME) B WHERE a.RECORD_ID = B.RECORD_ID ) group by color_code) WHERE ( (color_code = '1_RED' and total > 0) OR ( color_code ='2_GREEN'  and total > 0) OR (color_code = '3_BLUE' and  total > 0)) AND ROWNUM = 1
CMS_CTM_DETAILS_QUERY: SELECT a.EXTRACT_NAME, a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, a.STATUS, CASE a.STATUS WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN 'GREEN' WHEN 'DATA_POPULATED' THEN 'BLUE' WHEN 'NO_ELIGIBLE_DATA' THEN 'BLUE' ELSE 'RED' END COLOR_CODE FROM xxcms.XXCMS_INTERFACE_TRACKING A, (SELECT EXTRACT_NAME, MAX(RECORD_ID) RECORD_ID FROM xxcms.XXCMS_INTERFACE_TRACKING WHERE source_type = 'CTM' AND extract_name IN ('CUSTOMER_MASTER', 'CUSTOMER_CONTACTS', 'ALTERNATE_PAYER', 'OP_AR_EXTRACT', 'CL_AR_EXTRACT', 'SIH_EXTRACT', 'SII_EXTRACT') GROUP BY EXTRACT_NAME) B WHERE a.RECORD_ID = B.RECORD_ID
CMS_BOOMI_STATUS_QUERY: SELECT substr(color_code,3,length(color_code)-2) color FROM (select color_code, count(*) total from (SELECT a.EXTRACT_NAME, a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, a.STATUS, CASE a.STATUS WHEN 'SFTP_SUCCESS' THEN '3_BLUE' ELSE '2_GREEN' END COLOR_CODE FROM xxcms.XXCMS_INTERFACE_TRACKING A, (SELECT EXTRACT_NAME, MAX(RECORD_ID) RECORD_ID FROM xxcms.XXCMS_INTERFACE_TRACKING WHERE source_type = 'BOOMI' AND extract_name IN ('CUSTOMER_MASTER', 'CUSTOMER_CONTACTS', 'ALTERNATE_PAYER', 'OP_AR_EXTRACT', 'CL_AR_EXTRACT', 'SIH_EXTRACT', 'SII_EXTRACT') GROUP BY EXTRACT_NAME) B WHERE a.RECORD_ID = B.RECORD_ID ) group by color_code) WHERE ( (color_code = '1_RED' and total > 0) OR ( color_code ='2_GREEN'  and total > 0) OR (color_code = '3_BLUE' and  total > 0) ) AND ROWNUM = 1

I2C_CONTROLS_DETAILS_FILTERED_VIEW: select * from ARFINRO.TSP_OP_I2C_CTRL_DETAIL_VIEW WHERE period_name=? and application_name=? and OPERATING_UNIT_NAME=? and trunc(transaction_date)=to_date(?,'MM/DD/YYYY')
REV_CONTROLS_SUMMARY: SELECT * FROM XXCFIANR.XXCFIR_ANR_REV_AUDIT_SUMMARY_V WHERE "Transaction Date" IS NOT NULL
REV_CONTROLS_DETAILS_VIEW: select * from ARFINRO.TSP_REV_OP_CONTROL_DETAIL_VIEW WHERE TRANSACTION_DATE IS NOT NULL
REV_CONTROLS_DETAILS_FILTERED_VIEW: select * from ARFINRO.TSP_REV_OP_CONTROL_DETAIL_VIEW WHERE period_name=? and application_name=? and OPERATING_UNIT_NAME=? and trunc(transaction_date)=to_date(?,'MM/DD/YYYY')
GTC_CONTROLS_DETAILS_FILTERED_VIEW: select * from xxcfianr.XXCFI_GTC_CUST_ERROR_DTL_DASHBOARD_V where replace(process_flow,' ','')=replace(?,' ','') and BOOKING_ENTITY_NAME=? and trunc(transaction_date)=to_date(?,'MM/DD/YYYY')
XXCASEIQ_I2C_CASE_DETAILS_V_MATCH_Y: SELECT * FROM arfinro.XXCASEIQ_I2C_CASE_DETAILS_V WHERE CATEGORY_MATCH = 'Y' AND CORE_ISSUE_MATCH = 'Y'
XXCASEIQ_ESP_CASE_ANALYZER_TBL_UPDATE: UPDATE ARFINRO.XXCASEIQ_ESP_CASE_ANALYZER_TBL SET validated_by=?, validated_at=SYSDATE, category_actual=?, core_issue_actual=?, comments=?, case_analyzer_status = CASE WHEN UPPER(?) = UPPER(?) OR UPPER(?) = UPPER(?) THEN 'VALIDATED' ELSE 'ANALYZED' END, category_match = CASE WHEN UPPER(?) = UPPER(?) THEN 'Y' WHEN ? IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'N' END, core_issue_match = CASE WHEN UPPER(?) = UPPER(?) THEN 'Y' WHEN ? IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'N' END WHERE INCIDENT_NUMBER=? AND IMPACTED_SERVICE_OFFERING=?
ADMIN_TABLE: SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, ROLE_ID, USER_ROLE, ENABLED_FLAG, TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATION_DATE, USER_EMAIL, CREATED_BY FROM ARFINRO.XXCFI_LARGE_DEAL_DSH_USER_ACCESS WHERE ENABLED_FLAG IS NOT NULL
CREATE_USER_ROLE: INSERT INTO ARFINRO.XXCFI_LARGE_DEAL_DSH_USER_ACCESS (USER_NAME, USER_EMAIL, ROLE_ID, USER_ROLE, ENABLED_FLAG, CREATION_DATE, CREATED_BY) SELECT ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ? FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ARFINRO.XXCFI_LARGE_DEAL_DSH_USER_ACCESS WHERE USER_NAME = ? AND USER_ROLE = ? AND ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y')
UPDATE_USER_ROLE: UPDATE ARFINRO.XXCFI_LARGE_DEAL_DSH_USER_ACCESS SET USER_EMAIL=?, ROLE_ID=?, ENABLED_FLAG=? WHERE USER_NAME=? AND USER_ROLE=? AND ENABLED_FLAG IS NOT NULL
DELETE_USER_ROLE: UPDATE ARFINRO.XXCFI_LARGE_DEAL_DSH_USER_ACCESS SET USER_EMAIL=?, ENABLED_FLAG=NULL WHERE USER_NAME=? AND USER_ROLE=? AND TO_CHAR(CREATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')=?
LOG_PAGE_VISIT: MERGE INTO ARFINRO.CTL_TWR_JSR_PAGE_VISIT_LOG tgt USING (SELECT ? AS USER_NAME, ? AS PAGE_ROUTE, TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS VISIT_DATE FROM DUAL) src ON (tgt.USER_NAME = src.USER_NAME AND tgt.PAGE_ROUTE = src.PAGE_ROUTE AND tgt.VISIT_DATE = src.VISIT_DATE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET tgt.LAST_VISIT_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP, tgt.VISIT_COUNT = tgt.VISIT_COUNT + 1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_NAME, PAGE_ROUTE, VISIT_DATE, FIRST_VISIT_TIME, LAST_VISIT_TIME, VISIT_COUNT) VALUES (src.USER_NAME, src.PAGE_ROUTE, src.VISIT_DATE, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, 1)
GET_PAGE_VISIT_ANALYTICS: SELECT USER_NAME, PAGE_ROUTE, VISIT_DATE, TO_CHAR(FIRST_VISIT_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FIRST_VISIT_TIME, TO_CHAR(LAST_VISIT_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_VISIT_TIME, VISIT_COUNT FROM ARFINRO.CTL_TWR_JSR_PAGE_VISIT_LOG ORDER BY VISIT_DATE DESC, VISIT_COUNT DESC
GET_PAGE_VISIT_SUMMARY: SELECT PAGE_ROUTE, SUM(VISIT_COUNT) AS TOTAL_VISITS, COUNT(DISTINCT USER_NAME) AS UNIQUE_USERS FROM ARFINRO.CTL_TWR_JSR_PAGE_VISIT_LOG GROUP BY PAGE_ROUTE ORDER BY TOTAL_VISITS DESC
